sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement (virtual/physical mode).

2. The Petitioner being in custody in connection with Banarpal P.S. Case No.46 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. Case No.216 of 2021 on the file of learned S.D.J.M., Angul running for commission of offence under sections 420/272/273/468/471/34, I.P.C. read with sections 51/52/56/59/63 of the Food Safety and Stands Act, 2006, section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sections 32/36 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Act has filed this application under section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for his release on bail.
3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

// 2 //
4. Taking into account the submissions made; further keeping in view the materials on records as those stand against the Petitioner with other surrounding circumstances including the period of detention of the Petitioner in custody and on going through the order passed by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum Special Judge; in the absence of any such impediment; it is directed that the Petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the court in seisin of the case with further conditions that he will appear in person before the court in seisin of the case on each date of posting of the case till Paramananda Sahu vs State Of Odisha ....
